text:
mike: Heads-up: scheduling a midroll maintenance in us-east2 next Wednesday 02:45-05:00 UTC to address sporadic NIC queue stalls and one flaky PCIe lane. We'll do staggered mini-drains to avoid big KV cold starts.

ana: ETA on usable-GPU loss? which pools affected?

mike: ~6-10% usable GPU reduction at peak. Affected pools: atlas-us and orbit-us. We've listed two high-priority tenants in the runbook for heads-up.

kevin: Can we do 3-tier canaries? single-rack, cross-ToR pair, then minibatches. Keeps cold-hit surface small and surfaces switch regressions.

mike: Yup. Canaries: rack-7 (single) then rack-19 + rack-20 cross-ToR. Minibatches: 1 rack per wave, ~8-10m including kv-seed. Sequence: cordon -> evict noncritical -> soft-reboot -> smoke -> kv-seed -> restore.

ops-bot: maintenance ticket created (#6120). 60m and 15m reminders scheduled.

sara: cost/egress: if we shift heavy routes to us-west for 90m, what's egress delta? need a conservative number for finops.

kevin: current us-east2 outbound ~1.0TB/h. If we shift 1.5h to us-west at $0.10/GB -> 1000GB * 1.5 * 0.10 = $150. Add 20% buffer for retries/double-serving => ~$180. Tag flows with maint=6120.

finops: noted. Approve up to $250 for this window; please label traffic and include a spend estimate in the ticket.

ana: networking note: rack-19 ToR had an SFP swap last month; rack-20 is older. Good to separate them for canary. If we see asymmetric packet retrans spikes, abort and isolate the offending ToR.

mike: failure criteria: smoke p99 > baseline*1.5 OR error rate >2% OR sustained TCP retrans > threshold. On fail: abort, uncordon last wave, revert routing weights, emergency kv-seed job, page infra lead.

sara: autoscaler tweak? suggest max-surge +5% and short-term increased scale-up aggressiveness to help absorb the soft-evac.

mike: done. i'll add that to the runbook. Also adding a temporary routing override for slo>=99.9 to prefer us-west during the heaviest batches; will remove after window.

ops-bot: 30m reminder scheduled to post in #oncall.

kevin: small ops nit: add a step to set client timeout to 12s during the window to reduce client-side retries and double-serving.

mike: added. runbook snippet: 
```
02:30 UTC - preflight: telemetry, reserve 12% slots, notify owners
02:45 - canary1 rack-7: cordon -> soft-reboot -> smoke -> kv-seed
03:00 - canary2 cross-ToR (rack-19 + rack-20) repeat
03:20 - minibatches across racks (8-10m each)
04:50 - final sweep, de-cordon, postflight metrics
```

ana: who owns smoke tests? can someone validate embeddings p99 and gen tail-latency?

kevin: i'll own embeddings p99 checks. sara takes gen tail. we'll post snapshots here.

finops: reminder: label egress with "maint=6120" and include a tracing header for attribution. if forecasted spend nears $250, alert finance for manual approval.

mike: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/us-east2/midroll-6120 (preflight checklist). calendar invite and owners assigned. ping here if any risks. :white_check_mark:
